title: remaining harness gates, allocator isolation and reproducibility hygiene are closed
decision: retained, harness and gate hygiene work in tools and documentation
code_state: no file under crates/ changed; the harness remains under tools/; native-resave lock metadata was refreshed; no production dependency or public API changed
reason_codes: 0651 row 13 and the 0669 handoff left the public XLSB workbook-structure lifecycle without a shared baseline selector; the opt-in selector now times edit_workbook_structure planning/commit, apply_workbook_structure and save with typed reopen evidence

0651 row 17 left one missing PPTX opened-transaction phase selector after 0664 landed the marker-bearing corpora, ordinary-save allocation regions and DOCX text-sink selectors; the new selector records six public stages with explicit enclosing-total and semantic-reopen gates

0651 row 19 left the docx,odt facade feature pair outside the standing gate and left process-global allocator tests exposed to default parallelism; named modes now compile the feature pair and serialize the allocator binary

0651 row 19 also identified a stale native-resave lockfile and a broad repository log ignore rule; the lockfile is regenerated and docs/performance/results/**/*.log is explicitly visible for packet owners

0651 row 20's release reproducibility finding is documented at the harness boundary: binary_identity names the executable timed under lto=true, while byte-for-byte rebuilds require separately audited toolchain, linker and profile settings
the structural claim checker now supports structural-only validation without retained evidence; strict mode still requires --evidence-root and independently verifies all ten claims

accepted_evidence.pptx_phase_selector: pptx_semantic_opened_transaction_phases is registered, parsed, dispatched and exercised by the tiny semantic test and a JSON smoke run; six phase vectors, total_ns, output digests and semantic reopen gates are retained
accepted_evidence.facade_polyglot_gate: non_iwork_gate.py facade-polyglot-tests runs cargo test for litchi with --no-default-features --features docx,odt --lib --tests --no-fail-fast and one test thread; all 95 facade library tests and integration targets pass
accepted_evidence.allocator_gate: non_iwork_gate.py harness-tests keeps its default suite and adds the allocator-metrics docx_bounded_tail_append_compare binary with --test-threads=1; all five allocator tests pass
accepted_evidence.native_resave_lock: cargo metadata --locked and cargo check --locked --offline pass for tools/native-resave after offline lockfile regeneration
accepted_evidence.source_and_registry_tests: Python test modules for the gate planner, perf-baseline source policy, corpus manifest, CRUD coverage and corpus binding pass with 59, 26, 12, 41 and 9 tests
accepted_evidence.harness_quality: cargo fmt, cargo clippy --lib --tests -- -D warnings, the semantic tiny test, the XLSB lifecycle test and the updated selectable-case count test pass; the prior full sweep only failed on the stale count
accepted_evidence.claims_diagnostic: structural mode returns status 0 and validates ten claims without opening retained evidence; strict mode with --evidence-root . returns status 0 and independently validates the same ten claims
accepted_evidence.tracked_packet_log: gates.log remains tracked through the general negation !docs/performance/results/**/*.log; unrelated logs such as docs/performance/README.log remain ignored by the broad *.log rule
accepted_evidence.xlsb_structure_selector: xlsb_semantic_workbook_structure_edit_save is registered, parsed, dispatched and exercised by the XLSB lifecycle test and JSON smoke run; planning, publication and save vectors, output digest, phase-sum and typed semantic-reopen gates are retained

accepted_costs.allocator_serialization: the allocator subcommand is intentionally serial and separate from the fast default harness suite because its process-global counter is not thread-safe
accepted_costs.native_lock_refresh: the lockfile refresh updates transitive registry versions to the current offline index; cargo check is run locked and offline
accepted_costs.structural_mode: structural mode intentionally validates shape, repository references and cross-field policy without retained evidence; the explicitly named strict workflow step remains the required evidence gate
accepted_costs.full_harness_sweep: the already completed broad sweep took about 568 seconds; after the count assertion changed, only the affected count test was rerun to avoid another heavyweight sweep

known_gaps.native_resave_warnings: the native-resave stub binary still emits four existing unused/dead-code warnings under cargo check
known_gaps.full_after_count_sweep: the entire 529-test harness library was not rerun after changing the expected selector count; the preceding sweep passed every test except that exact stale assertion, and the affected count and XLSB lifecycle tests pass after the update

withheld: any speedup, latency, allocation, RSS, physical-I/O, cold-cache, producer or cross-platform claim
any claim that the ignore rule stages historical or unrelated untracked logs automatically

provenance.cpu_pin: none; focused gates use CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and no timing claim
provenance.commit: the tip of perf/0674-performance-gate-hygiene; a commit cannot record its own hash
